entities.summary: John Houstoun was an American lawyer and statesman from Savannah, Georgia. He was one of the original Sons of Liberty and also a delegate for Georgia in the Second Continental Congress in 1775. He was the Governor of Georgia from 1778 – 1779 and again from 1784 – 1785.
